comment: Arena mutators: pick 1 of 3 at each checkpoint; it lasts until the next one. Effects: vectorDamage (axis -> multiplier, everyone), enemyHpMul, chargeAll (every enemy attack telegraphs that many turns earlier), mpRegen (party, per turn), fireSpreads, rewardMul, noRest.

mutators.name: Early warning
mutators.text: Enemies telegraph 1 turn earlier, but have +30% HP.

mutators.name: High stakes
mutators.text: Double rewards, but no resting at the next checkpoint.

mutators.name: Thick skin
mutators.text: Enemies have +50% HP; score bonus doubled.

mutators.name: Force field
mutators.text: +50% Force damage, and collisions hurt everyone.
